add-column: Adds one nullable sso_provider_id column without a default to session and one to account; neither rewrites rows, and each catalog lock is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-table-references: Creates two new empty tables whose foreign keys reference organization and user; the reference takes a short catalog lock on each parent, bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-trigger: Creates an update guard on the new, empty sso_provider table; no other table is touched.
row-level-security: Enables (and on the policy table forces) row-level security on the two new, empty tables before any application reads them.
create-policy: Creates owner-only and request-role deny policies on the two new, empty tables.
